بـ 120 إطارًا على PS5

note: Primaries: PS Store JP product page (End of Eternity ENHANCED REMASTER, PS5, 4,070 yen, 2026/10/30, tri-Ace) and US concept page (Resonance of Fate ENHANCED REMASTER, PS5, USD 34.99); Steam page app 4996080 (tri-Ace): native 4K, HDR, 120 fps, upscaled textures, new 2x Game Speed; PC version is DLC on the 4K/HD Edition. Out now PS5 and PC per Gematsu (00:15Z, citing tri-Ace). First release 2010 (PS3, Xbox 360). Footage: tri-Ace's 2018 RESONANCE OF FATE 4K/HD EDITION trailer from Steam app 645730 (no trailer for the Enhanced Remaster exists), cut 74-158 s at crf 18 and committed under live/; decode clean; 1080p60 7.4 Mbps; the 4K/HD reborn title card (90-93 s) and the letterboxed opening are not used; credit names the 2018 edition. Sound: one stretch of the trailer's own music from 137.15 s original (63.15 in the cut): speechcheck --stretch hears the last word ('fate!') end at 62.84 in the cut and nothing after it to the cut's end at 84.0 (an earlier full-file pass placed 'Get out of the way!' at 83.8); the Reel body is 20.6 s, so the track ends at 83.75. pace_ok: two shots carry their own trailer cut (s9 87.4-89.4 cuts at 88). Shots end before the trailer's hexagon wipes (26.3 and 36.8 in the cut, flagged by the smear check). v2 (director FIX on v1): headline's second shot is Leanne's bridal portrait (was a grey wide crop); bar shot focused on the characters (was the wine glass); villain shot ends before the trailer's red flash; the upward torso shot replaced by the gun-drawn woman; line 4 rides her and the girl at the window; close on the white-coat character. v3 (director FIX on v2): second headline shot starts at 88.7 (v2 caught the fade into the title card); the bar shot replaced by the man at 97 s (autofocus kept the wine glass); the girl-at-window shot replaced by the library man and the man in the suit at 123.4 s (v2 showed the hexagon wipe and an empty window).
block_ok: looked at the frames: a clean scene cut from Leanne to the carnival's dense neon signs (edge count, not decode damage); shot 0 now ends at 6.4 before it
